families.label: Flowchart
families.relationship: Branching processes, decisions, boundaries, and feedback.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all nine semantic classes across a dependency chain.
families.accessibleDescription: Nine styled process roles form an ordered validation path from the primary entry through the neutral terminal role.

families.label: Swimlane
families.relationship: Responsibility-separated work and cross-lane handoffs.
families.complexityNote: Exercises three lanes and all nine semantic classes.
families.accessibleDescription: Nine styled process roles move in order across three responsibility lanes and expose two cross-lane handoffs.

families.label: Sequence
families.relationship: Messages, activation, alternatives, and concurrency over time.
families.complexityNote: Unbounded family; the advanced fixture combines actor boxes, activation, critical, option, alt, opt, par, and autonumber.
families.accessibleDescription: A user import request crosses a front door and platform, then branches through critical capacity handling, warning and rejection alternatives, parallel worker persistence, and auditing.

families.label: Class
families.relationship: Types and their structural relationships.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all nine semantic classes in one relationship chain.
families.accessibleDescription: Nine class roles form an ordered dependency chain and expose every semantic class available to the Mermaid styler.

families.label: State
families.relationship: Valid states, transitions, entry, and exit.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all nine semantic classes plus initial and terminal states.
families.accessibleDescription: A lifecycle advances through nine explicitly styled states from the initial marker to the terminal marker.

families.label: Entity Relationship
families.relationship: Entities and cardinality-bearing relationships.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all nine semantic classes and eight one-to-many relations.
families.accessibleDescription: Nine entities form eight ordered one-to-many relationships and expose every semantic class available to the styler.

families.label: User Journey
families.relationship: Stages, tasks, actors, and satisfaction.
families.complexityNote: Shows seven distinct section classes plus the eighth cycling boundary.
families.accessibleDescription: Eight ordered journey sections show satisfaction changing from five to one and back to four; the eighth section demonstrates the documented color cycle.

families.label: Gantt
families.relationship: Tasks, dates, durations, dependencies, and status.
families.complexityNote: Exercises normal, active, done, critical, active-critical, and done-critical task roles.
families.accessibleDescription: Six dated tasks expose every Gantt status combination from normal through done-critical.

families.label: Pie
families.relationship: Non-negative parts of a whole.
families.complexityNote: Uses all twelve slice colors before the scheme repeats.
families.accessibleDescription: Twelve slices descend from value twelve to one and occupy every available pie color slot before reuse.

families.label: Quadrant
families.relationship: Items positioned against two named axes.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all four semantic quadrant domains.
families.accessibleDescription: Four labeled points occupy the invest, explore, defer, and maintain domains of an effort versus impact matrix.

families.label: Requirement
families.relationship: Requirements, risk, verification, and trace relations.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all nine semantic classes across nine traced requirements.
families.accessibleDescription: Nine requirements with low, medium, and high risk form an eight-link containment trace and expose every semantic class.

families.label: GitGraph
families.relationship: Branches and commits through repository history.
families.complexityNote: Uses all eight branch colors including the main branch.
families.accessibleDescription: The main branch creates seven feature branches, each with a labeled commit, and consumes all eight GitGraph branch color slots.

families.label: C4
families.relationship: People and software at C4 abstraction levels.
families.complexityNote: Unbounded family; the advanced fixture includes people, internal and external systems, styled elements, styled relations, and layout configuration.
families.accessibleDescription: A skill author updates a repository that supplies Mermaid source to an external renderer and browser, with four directed review and publication relationships.

families.label: Mindmap
families.relationship: A concept and its hierarchical associations.
families.complexityNote: Uses the root plus eleven level-one branches for all twelve scale colors.
families.accessibleDescription: One central concept has eleven first-level branches and consumes the complete twelve-color mindmap scale including the root.

families.label: Timeline
families.relationship: Events grouped in chronological sections.
families.complexityNote: Uses all twelve timeline section colors before cycling.
families.accessibleDescription: Twelve dated sections span the first twelve days of January 2026 and consume every timeline scale color before reuse.

families.label: ZenUML
families.relationship: Code-like interactions and conditional behavior.
families.complexityNote: Unbounded family; the advanced fixture combines actor, boundary, database, request-response, and conditional blocks.
families.accessibleDescription: An author asks a documentation boundary to load Mermaid source from a repository, then receives either a colored render or a parser error according to frontmatter validity.

families.label: Sankey
families.relationship: Weighted movement between sources and destinations.
families.complexityNote: Uses eight distinct node colors before the configured map cycles.
families.accessibleDescription: Eight nodes form a descending weighted flow from value eight to value two and consume every configured Sankey node color.

families.label: XY Chart
families.relationship: Series compared along shared numeric axes.
families.complexityNote: Uses six plot series; Colorset 2 reaches its sixth color while Colorset 1 demonstrates the documented five-color cycle.
families.accessibleDescription: Six alternating bar and line series increase across four categories and expose the extended palette tail and standard palette cycle.

families.label: Block
families.relationship: Blocks arranged in an explicit spatial grid.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all nine semantic classes in a three-by-three layout.
families.accessibleDescription: Nine styled blocks occupy a three-column grid and form three ordered relationship rows.

families.label: Packet
families.relationship: Bit fields, offsets, and widths in a packet.
families.complexityNote: Unbounded family; the advanced fixture lays out a complete 32-bit transport header with twelve fields.
families.accessibleDescription: A 32-bit transport header is divided into source and destination ports, sequence and acknowledgment values, control flags, window, checksum, pointer, options, and payload fields.

families.label: Kanban
families.relationship: Cards grouped by workflow state.
families.complexityNote: Uses all ten reachable colored columns in Mermaid 11.16.0.
families.accessibleDescription: Ten workflow columns each contain one card and consume every reachable Kanban column color from section one through section ten.

families.label: Architecture
families.relationship: Services, groups, ports, and routed connections.
families.complexityNote: Exercises grouped and ungrouped services plus horizontal and vertical port routing.
families.accessibleDescription: Ingress reaches an API and worker across edge and core groups; the worker routes to database, queue, and archive services.

families.label: Radar
families.relationship: Multivariable profiles on a shared radial scale.
families.complexityNote: Uses all twelve curve colors before additional curves lose a new slot.
families.accessibleDescription: Twelve four-axis curves rotate values from one through twelve and consume every generated radar curve color.

families.label: Event Modeling
families.relationship: UI, commands, events, read models, and processors.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all five semantic Event Modeling roles.
families.accessibleDescription: One timeline frame each represents a user interface, processor, read model, command, and event role.

families.label: Treemap
families.relationship: Quantitative hierarchy encoded by area.
families.complexityNote: Uses a named root plus eleven child groups for all twelve scale colors.
families.accessibleDescription: A named capacity root contains eleven descending-value groups and consumes all twelve named hierarchy colors including the root.

families.label: Venn
families.relationship: Set membership and overlap.
families.complexityNote: Uses all eight set colors before the scheme repeats.
families.accessibleDescription: Eight named sets descend from value twelve to value five and consume every available Venn set color.

families.label: Ishikawa
families.relationship: Nested causes converging on one effect.
families.complexityNote: Unbounded family; the advanced fixture uses six main branches and eighteen nested causes.
families.accessibleDescription: Delivery delay is traced to process, people, platform, policy, data, and environment branches, each with three nested causes.

families.label: Wardley
families.relationship: A value chain positioned against evolution.
families.complexityNote: Exercises anchor, build, buy, and outsource semantic roles across six linked components.
families.accessibleDescription: A user value chain descends through interface, API, worker, database, and archive components while moving from genesis toward commodity evolution.

families.label: Cynefin
families.relationship: Situations classified into decision domains.
families.complexityNote: Exercises all five fixed domains and a cross-domain relation.
families.accessibleDescription: One item occupies each of the complex, complicated, clear, chaotic, and confusion domains, with an analysis transition from complex to complicated.

families.label: TreeView
families.relationship: Directories and files in a rooted hierarchy.
families.complexityNote: Unbounded family; the advanced fixture spans five levels, six directories, and twelve files.
families.accessibleDescription: A project tree expands source, tests, documentation, scripts, reports, and assets through as many as five hierarchy levels.

families.label: Railroad
families.relationship: Grammar productions and parser routes.
families.complexityNote: Exercises terminal, nonterminal, sequence, and optional grammar roles; the family also exposes EBNF, ABNF, and PEG declarations.
families.accessibleDescription: The root grammar requires an identifier and expression, may include an operator, and resolves the expression to a number.
